title: What the Portal tells the core about one Business at call start
description: The one definition of the settings shape. The Portal serves it (portal/accounts/models.py as_settings) and the core reads it (VOI-25); tests/portal/test_settings_contract.py fails when either side drifts. The AI notice is not a setting and has no property here.

theme.description: The Business's Theme, optional and shown only to its Callers (GLOSSARY.md); absent for Voice's own look. `accent` is the colour as Callers see it, already adjusted by the Portal so `accent_text` on it meets WCAG 2.2 AA; the two come together. `logo_url` is the Portal's public address of the logo, which names no Business.

modules.description: The Business's Modules (MCP servers), optional. A remote Module has a url; a local one a command, which the core runs only where self-hosting allows it (ALLOW_LOCAL_MODULES). The Portal's Modules page (VOI-28) fills it.
